  List.foldl (fun acc x =>
    List.foldl (fun acc' y =>
      if y < x then acc'
      else max acc' (acc' + 1)
    ) 0 nums) 0 nums
  |>.max 0

def lengthOfLIS (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums)) : Int :=
  let rec aux (current : List Int) (acc : List Int) : List Int :=
    match current with
    | [] => acc
    | x :: xs =>
      if acc.isEmpty ∨ x > acc.head!.getD 0 then
        aux xs (x :: acc)
      else
        aux xs acc
  let rec compute (nums : List Int) : Int :=
    match nums with
    | [] => 0
    | x :: xs =>
      let rec helper (acc : List Int) (current : Int) : Int :=
        match acc with
        | [] => 0
        | y :: ys =>
          if y < current then
            helper ys current
          else
            let newAcc := y :: ys
            let newCurrent := current
            if newAcc.isEmpty ∨ current > newAcc.head!.getD 0 then
              helper newAcc newCurrent
            else
              helper newAcc newCurrent
      helper [] x
  compute nums

def lengthOfLIS (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums)) : Int :=
  match nums with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs =>
    let rec dp (current : List Int) (acc : List Int) : List Int :=
      match current with
      | [] => acc
      | y :: ys =>
        if acc.isEmpty ∨ y > acc.head!.getD 0 then
          dp ys (y :: acc)
        else
          dp ys acc
    let rec compute (nums : List Int) : Int :=
      match nums with
      | [] => 0
      | x :: xs =>
        let newAcc := dp xs []
        let len := newAcc.length
        if len > 0 then len else 0
    compute nums
